grandparents_cupboard.reason: Sausages, chicken stock, dried pasta and Parmesan are all ordinary kitchen staples, and there are no jars, stock pots or packet mixes.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only two pans and a masher, and the techniques are simple browning, simmering and mashing.

works.reason: Six sausages, a whole squash and 400g pasta suit four, 300ml stock covered for 15 minutes will soften diced squash, and the saved pasta water loosens the sauce.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers peeling and dicing a squash, chopping an onion and garlic, skinning the sausages and grating the cheese, and the stepped times of about 28 minutes are close to the 25 printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm squash and sausage pasta suits late February, and the squash forms the body of the sauce rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are brief, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling family meal of sausage, vegetables and pasta that people would happily cook again.
